findings: A bounded later-LR preparation component supports slots1..8 only. It rebinds independently frozen requests, complete pilot cleanup history, every completed quality member and all remaining-panel storage before publishing the next immutable request.

Attempts, failures, finished1800s/4GiB RSS/8GiB reserve preparation guards, prefix records/pairs and exact pre-request inventory remain retained. It neither authorizes a process nor selects rates, performs cleanup or advances to rank/fresh stages. Failed or existing preparation cannot retry.

Integration exposed that an inventory collected from disk could bind unknown quality files and make them pass the old supplied-inventory completeness check. V2 producer review now enforces an explicit artifact/directory allowlist in addition to hash binding; unknown output remains rejected even when included in the inventory.
A missing tensor files mapping previously raised KeyError; explicit validation now rejects it with ValueError. Both initial test failures are retained.

Slots1/4/8 preserve all existing evidence and checkpoint pairs. Exact full remaining-space threshold passes and one byte less fails before request creation; occupied checkpoint capacity reduces remaining requirements without deleting or treating those weights as free bytes.

The final337-test run passed with real outer-guard disk readings, including prefix/full-stage audits, tensor producer, quality execution and storage regressions. A shared shutil mock was isolated after an intermediate passing run so the final resource evidence uses actual disk capacity.
limitations: Full frozen-plan/numerical gates and model/MPS producer evidence are synthetic in transition tests; real bounded writers, inherited locks, pilot cleanup receipts, prefix audit semantics and storage arithmetic execute. Only disposable synthetic pilot weights are removed by fixture setup; no research checkpoints are touched.

Preparation does not yet implement later-LR predispatch revalidation, exact child process handoff, dispatch receipt acceptance, saved LR/rank selection transitions, LR/rank cleanup or inference orchestration. There is no new training launch CLI.

The real nine rank-policy optimizer/update/resume/EMA/input and measured-pilot prerequisites remain unresolved. No failed combined numerical fixture or closed controller was rerun. The27-trajectory campaign is unfrozen; no research training/MPS launch, quality claim or test-holdout access occurred.
